title: NASA Blue Marble (2002): land, ocean color, sea ice and clouds
orientation: north-to-south rows; -180 to +180 longitude columns; antimeridian at the seam
memoryNote: Nominal RGBA8 full mip chain; excludes driver padding and decoded CPU image memory.

source.credit: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center; Reto Stöckli; enhancements by Robert Simmon; MODIS science teams
source.note: Historical satellite composite, not live weather. Clouds and surface share one color map.

preparation.processing: Lanczos3 resize; sRGB; remove alpha; JPEG quality 85, mozjpeg, 4:2:0 chroma; strip metadata; no geographic flip or crop.
